column1: # Vendor ssh-mcp 2.18.0 classifier cases (docs/migration/vendor-ssh-mcp-rules.md section 1.13 and 7.1). UTF-8, columns separated by one TAB:
#   id  input  class  binary  rejectionBinary  rejectionWord  note
# input and rejectionWord: <EMPTY> the empty string, <SP> a space, <TAB> <LF> <CR> <NBSP> <NUL> one character, <U+00A0>-style any code point.
# binary: empty = not checked. rejectionBinary: empty = not checked, "-" = the classification has no read-only rejection, otherwise the binary of the rejection.
# note: CHANGED = the expected class is stricter than the vendor's (intended behavior change, stage 2 design 13.4).
# Cases that need a generated input (VR-013, VR-014, VR-133, VR-134, VR-290, VR-291) and the engine cases (VR-192, VR-204, VR-315, VR-316) are in the test classes.
